Book of the Week!
Best Friends
Zindzi and Tim Tam do everything together, and Zindzi can't imagine choosing anyone else to play with. A gentle illustrated story about friendship, kindness and including others.
Latest Online Storybooks
Koschei the Deathless
A tyrant hides his soul and brings the Earth to ruin. A dark Russian folklore retelling.
Rumpelstiltskin
A dark Halloween retelling of Rumpelstiltskin, in which Rosie must outwit a nameless trickster to reclaim her own power back.
The Iron Wolf
A young man makes a deadly pact with the Iron Wolf, and must face his fears with some loyal dogs.
5 Minute Stories
5 minute stories for short and sweet snuggles before bedtime…
The Halloween Fairies
A playful Halloween story for kids about friendship, creativity, spooky costumes and fairy-ring magic.
Cody in the Cretaceous
Cody Cat has built a time machine, and has landed in the Cretaceous. But uh-oh... there's a lot of glitches!
Olive Stays In
Olive's school has closed, and she and her family have to stay in the house... a book to help parents talk about coronavirus.
Sam’s Treasures
Sam thinks he is collecting treasures in the garden. His sister says it is junk. Who is right?
How Jack Went To Seek His Fortune
Clever Jack has a menagerie of animals to outwit a robber gang!
Amazing Daisy!
A chicken wants to learn how to fly... practice makes perfect!

Fairy tales that make you feel good… with all the bad bits taken out!
The Picky Prince, the Princess and the Peanut (Feel Good Fairy Tales)
A picky Prince must marry - what happens when a mechanic Princess arrives at his door?
Yummy, Happy, Good-Time Soup!
When Mabel meets a curious old lady in the forest, she is gifted a marvellous machine...
Huffy Puffy Wolf
Huffy Puffy Wolf is a bit too huffy and puffy! With the help of some friends, he's going to get fit!

Little Red Riding Hood is going to enjoy some delicious food with her Grandma... but meets big slobbery Oscar on the way!

Lily meets a Big, Bad, BAD-MANNERED wolf on the way to Grandma's house! Will they let him join them for their picnic?

Fairy tales for older children, teens and curious readers who enjoy lyrical, authentic folk tale and mythical retellings with deeper themes.
Tamlane
A Scottish fairy tale of love, courage, and magic, as Janet braves the Fairy Queen’s enchantments to rescue Tamlane.
The Burning Girls
A dark Halloween retelling of the fairy tale Little Red Riding Hood...
The Brave Life of Little Pea
The fantastic adventures of a brave boy who rescues his family from demons.
The Kingdom of the Sea Tsar
A greedy Prince dives into the Sea Tsar’s shimmering realm and demands the whole kingdom for himself. A lyrical fairy tale for older readers about misuse…
The Silver Grass Circle of Valbonne
A fairy tale about cousins Freya and Matteo, who must outwit an Elf King in an enchanted forest dance.

A dark fairy tale retelling of the classic tale of generosity, greed and gratitude.

Baby and toddler books designed to delight and engage the youngest readers.
Little Ant’s Big Plan
Little Ant has read about restaurants - and wants to use his knowledge to help others.
Monday Undies
Ted is a big boy and wears big boy undies! But something goes wrong when the washing happens!
Jimmy the Cat and Bobik’s Birthday
Jimmy's friend Bobik is having a birthday party, and Jimmy and his friends try to decide the perfect presents.
Whose Shoe Is This?
Fezile is looking for his grandmother's shoes, but keeps finding other ones!
Bathtub Safari
A boy loves bath time - that's when all the animals come out!
How About You?
You don’t need to be alike to be friends. When two very different children meet an unusual creature, it’s a chance to ask, How About You?

Two of a Kind
Two squirrel siblings can't stop competing... and causing chaos wherever they go!
Princess Pink Knickers
Princess Donnabella Petronella Rosebud MUST have the most beautiful dress for her parade. But is a magic dress really a dress?
Ukrainian Space Hotel
A cosmic fairytale - the Ukrainian Space Hotel is a refuge where children can create their own world... Featuring the amazing illustrations of the children of…
Comfier Than Mine!

Sunshine Stories
The Sunshine tells stories about all whom she has shined upon.
Bones Who Woke Too Late
When Bones, a playful Halloween skeleton, accidentally wakes up in the heart of winter, he finds himself in a world transformed by the magic of Christmas!
Babiole
A Princess is turned into a monkey called Babiole by a wicked fairy's spell.

Olive's school has closed, and she and her family have to stay in the house... a book to help parents talk about coronavirus.

From morning swings to afternoon picnics, a rhyming storybook about a delightful day of outdoor fun.
Did You Ever ?

Little Painters
A brother and sister start painting a gate - but they do it in two different colours!
That Face
A determined girl tries and tries... pulling a special face whenever she’s ready to try again!

Developers and other customers are encouraged to incorporate the O*NET database within their products, services, and research. The O*NET Database: A Primary Source of Occupational Information
The O*NET database has a wide variety of worker and job oriented data categories. The
O*NET Content Model
provides the framework that identifies and organizes this important information about work. The
O*NET-SOC Occupation Taxonomy
covers work performed in the U.S. economy and defines the set of occupations for which data is collected.
The O*NET Data Collection Program currently makes updates to the O*NET Database on a quarterly basis, with a primary update occurring in the 3
rd
quarter of each year. Listings showing data updates by category or occupation are available on the
Occupation Update Summary
page. See
Data Publication Schedule
for a listing of primary updates and collection history. Past releases of the O*NET Database are available on the
Database Releases Archive
page.

What is RDF?
Resource Description Framework (RDF) is a framework for expressing information about resources. Resources can be anything, including documents, physical objects, and abstract concepts. In O*NET, resources include individual skills, occupations, and numeric data ratings.
RDF defines an interoperable way for different organizations and groups to link data together from multiple sources. Learn more from the W3C’s
RDF Primer
external site
.

Machine-Discoverable Data
The O*NET Database contains over 1 million RDF resources representing skills, occupations, numeric data ratings, and more. Each of these resources is not only downloadable above, but accessible online through its identifier. In technical terms, every resource IRI is also a valid URL. Permanent IRIs are used which always point to the latest version of a resource, so automated tools can get up-to-date information on specific variables in real time.
The full database is machine discoverable through JSON-LD embedded within this page. Due to the size of the database, only a top-level Dublin Core Dataset is embedded. Automated tools can traverse the “hasPart” properties to discover the entire database.

includes worker- and job-oriented hierarchical taxonomies that can effectively serve as frameworks for organizing workforce competencies, credentials, and other work-relevant information.
These frameworks are available in Excel format and also as machine-readable CTDL JSON-LD files, described using the Credential Transparency Description Language (CTDL) Achievement Standards Network (ASN)

O*NET Web Services
provides real-time, up-to-date access to all of the information in the downloadable O*NET Database. With these services, programmers and researchers can:
Programmatically discover every file in the database, and what data each file contains
Retrieve all data from any part of the database
Filter and sort results based on multiple criteria
The Database Services API always provides the latest version of the O*NET Database (currently 31.0), with no need to worry about downloading and integrating quarterly updates.
